\section{Branches and probes}
% [D2] iftex names, nested
Engine: \ifPDFTeX pdfTeX\else\ifXeTeX XeTeX\else\ifLuaTeX LuaTeX\else other\fi\fi\fi.
% [D1] format probe at author level
\ifx\pdfoutput\undefined No \verb|\pdfoutput|.\else \verb|\pdfoutput| is defined.\fi
% [D4] flag by definedness; master.tex defines \gmarxiv
\ifdefined\gmarxiv arXiv build.\else\newpage\fi
% [D7] ifthen boolean and etoolbox toggle
\ifthenelse{\boolean{gmlong}}{Long version.}{Short version.}
\iftoggle{gmtoggle}{Toggle on.}{Toggle off.}
% [D8] parametric \ifcsname over a name built by \gmsetcap
\ifcsname gmcap@fig1\endcsname Cap is \csname gmcap@fig1\endcsname.\fi
% [D9] emptiness test, \ifmmode inside a macro, \ifcase, \unless, a \loop
Empty: \gmifempty{}{yes}{no}; \gmpp\ and $\gmpp$.
\newcount\gmn
\gmn=0
\loop\ifnum\gmn<3 \advance\gmn by 1 [\the\gmn]\repeat
\ifcase\gmn zero\or one\or two\or three\else many\fi;
\unless\ifdefined\gmundefinedflag unless-test passed\fi.
% [D12] \iff in live text
$A \iff B$.
